# Ferryx

> Ferryx is a terminal workspace that runs coding agents in panes on this machine and on paired or SSH hosts. `ferryx-cli` talks to the running Ferryx daemon; `ferryx-cli api list` and `ferryx-cli api describe <command>` print the command catalogue below as JSON.

This file is generated by `bun scripts/gen-llms-txt.mjs` from `ferryx-cli api list --json`; do not edit it by hand. Run `ferryx-cli api describe <command>` for the arguments, flags, exit codes and output of one command instead of parsing usage text.

## CLI

- [User guide](https://ferryx.dev/docs/guide/): installing Ferryx, workspaces, panes, remote access and agents
- [Technical architecture](https://ferryx.dev/docs/architecture/): the daemon, the desktop app and how ferryx-cli reaches them
- `ferryx-cli agents`: List, read, drive and wait on agent panes on this machine or a paired host. Verbs: `list`, `read`, `send`, `answer`, `stop`, `wait`, `events`. Output: json.
- `ferryx-cli supervisor`: Manage supervisor goals, project setup, work dispatch and the supervisor engine. Verbs: `goal set`, `goal show`, `goal mode`, `goal approve`, `goal discard`, `goal accept-revision`, `goal reject-revision`, `setup`, `submit`, `dispatch status`, `request`, `engine status`, `engine assess`. Output: json.
- `ferryx-cli hub`: Control the agent hub: lifecycle, omo migration, env import and cron jobs. Verbs: `migrate`, `stop`, `start`, `status`, `cutover`, `rollback`, `intake`, `env import`, `env keys`, `cron list`, `cron model`, `cron approve-rerun`. Output: text.
- `ferryx-cli mcp`: Serve the Ferryx MCP server over stdio. Output: mcp-stdio.
- `ferryx-cli open`: Open a file in the running Ferryx desktop app. Output: text.
- `ferryx-cli up`: Enroll this machine with the Ferryx account and install the background service. Output: text or json (--json).
- `ferryx-cli service`: Install, inspect or remove the OS background service for the daemon. Verbs: `install`, `status`, `uninstall`. Output: text or json (--json).
- `ferryx-cli account`: Enroll with a code, log in, or show the account plan. Verbs: `enroll`, `login`, `plan`. Output: text or json (plan --json).
- `ferryx-cli browser`: Drive Ferryx browser panes: navigation, DOM actions, queries, tabs and state. Verbs: `list`, `open`, `navigate`, `goto`, `back`, `forward`, `reload`, `close`, `identify`, `url`, `title`, `snapshot`, `click`, `dblclick`, `hover`, `check`, `uncheck`, `scroll-into-view`, `select`, `type`, `scroll`, `fill`, `keypress`, `eval`, `wait`, `screenshot`, `highlight`, `console`, `errors`, `focus`, `cookies`, `storage`, `get`, `is`, `find`, `dialog`, `download`, `tab`, `state`. Output: json.
- `ferryx-cli pair`: List paired devices or approve a PIN; PIN generation is retired and requires account enrollment. Verbs: `list`, `generate`, `approve`. Output: text.
- `ferryx-cli direct-trust`: Show this machine's direct-connection identity or pin/revoke a peer key. Verbs: `identity`, `provision`, `revoke`. Output: text.
- `ferryx-cli remote`: Show remote access status or pair a device. Verbs: `status`, `pair list`, `pair generate`, `pair approve`. Output: text or json (status --json).
- `ferryx-cli panes`: List detached sessions, attach owner-enabled plugin blocks, or detach, attach, zoom and swap live panes. Verbs: `list`, `detach`, `attach`, `zoom`, `swap`. Output: json array of detached backend session IDs; plugin attach returns a layout view.
- `ferryx-cli grants`: List or change which Ferryx pane may act on another pane (owner only, outside a pane). Verbs: `add`, `remove`, `list`. Output: json.
- `ferryx-cli integrations`: Show and manage the Ferryx hooks, skill and extension installed into each coding agent. Verbs: `status`, `skill install`, `skill status`, `skill uninstall`, `hooks install`, `hooks uninstall`. Output: json (status without --json prints text).
- `ferryx-cli api`: Describe the ferryx-cli command groups as JSON. Verbs: `list`, `describe`. Output: json.

## Agents

- [Ferryx agent skill](https://github.com/Indosaram/ferryx/blob/main/src-tauri/resources/agent-skills/ferryx/SKILL.md): the skill Ferryx installs into coding agents: supervising panes, integrations and status reporting
- [Agent support matrix](https://ferryx.dev/blog/agent-support-matrix/): which agents get status detection, hooks, resume and remote history
- [Running coding agents in parallel](https://ferryx.dev/use-cases/parallel-ai-agents/): one agent per pane and worktree
- [When an agent looks stuck](https://ferryx.dev/blog/agent-appears-stuck/): diagnosing a pane whose agent seems frozen

## Remote

- [Pair Ferryx with your phone](https://ferryx.dev/blog/pair-ferryx-with-phone/): reach your panes from a phone or another browser
- [Pairing troubleshooting](https://ferryx.dev/blog/pairing-troubleshooting/): when pairing a device fails
- [Remote terminal access](https://ferryx.dev/use-cases/remote-terminal-access/): terminals on other machines through the relay or SSH
- [Self-hosted relay](https://ferryx.dev/docs/self-hosted-relay/): running your own relay
- [Security and operations](https://ferryx.dev/docs/security/): the threat model, pairing keys and what the relay can see
